measure_design: classicalBranchComplexity = sum of sf.formula.complexity over unexpanded formulas on a branch. Strictly decreases per-branch under every expansion step (both alpha/beta), because all rule outputs are strict subformulas of the expanded formula. Total-sum can grow under beta (duplication), so the wire-up at L801 needs per-branch decrease + adjusted fuel bound or DM multiset ordering.
